scope: Constrained numeric feasibility only. No shader, project material or acceptance budget is changed. Values are sampled source display RGB; a nearest-lattice seed and damped local inversion estimate attainable scene-LUT colors. Local convergence does not prove a global impossibility.

convexInterpolationRangeProof.basis: Trilinear interpolation is a convex combination of LUT samples. Output components remain within lattice extrema.
